lines.t: Verse 1
They say it’s better, but it doesn’t look that way
They say they feel alive like it’s some perfect day
But when I look, I don’t feel whole
Just echoes of broken light down in my soul
And I can hear all the stories they sell
Pretty little lies that they tell themselves
Pre-Chorus
Smiles like smoke in the air so thin
But I can see what’s underneath it within
Chorus
I’m standing with Him, I don’t follow the crowd
In a world that feels louder than it should be out loud
I can read between the cracks in the glow
And I already know… it’s not better, no
They chase the shine like it’s something new
But it’s just empty dressed up like truth
Yeah I’m standing with Him, I see it clear
It’s not getting better here
Verse 2
Everybody’s moving like they’ve figured it out
Talking in circles just to drown out doubt
But I see the fractures under the light
In the pretty disguise of a half-lived life
And they say it’s better every day that goes by
But I can see it fading right behind their eyes
Pre-Chorus
Smiles like smoke in the air so thin
But I can see what’s underneath it within
Chorus
I’m standing with Him, I don’t follow the crowd
In a world that feels louder than it should be out loud
I can read between the cracks in the glow
And I already know… it’s not better, no
They chase the shine like it’s something new
But it’s just empty dressed up like truth
Yeah I’m standing with Him, I see it clear
It’s not getting better here
Bridge
And maybe they don’t see what I see
The way it all falls underneath
But I won’t trade what I know is real
For something that only learns to conceal
Final Chorus (bigger, more emotional)
I’m standing with Him, I won’t bend with the sound
In a world that keeps spinning but don’t slow down
I can read between the cracks in the glow
And I already know… it’s not better, no
No, they chase the shine like it’s something new
But it’s just empty dressed up like truth
Yeah I’m standing with Him, I see it clear
It’s not getting better here
